reviews.review_msg: Hard to rate the prof given that the course is just student seminars. Just hope for a good group because the seminars are led by students giving presentations. Grading criteria for presentations can be unclear, and the exam is textbook heavy. Ideally you should want to present later in the semester, so you can implement ideas from earlier groups.

Due to the course structure, Samantha doesn't teach & students present a seminar each week. The average is really high. It's not a good learning experience. The textbook isn't an easy read and concepts are Econ heavy. Samantha didn't guide us or give feedback. I'm not sure if that's her style, or if that's part of the course. Every man for himself.
Nice prof, but just be careful for the exam and presentation. Both takes a lot of time and energy
She is a good prof, but her exam is a bit challenging, but overall it could be manageable
